The error occurred because R8/ProGuard minification in the release build stripped generic signatures and TypeToken subclass metadata, preventing Gson from extracting the generic type parameter at runtime via reflection:

```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: TypeToken must be created with a type argument: new TypeToken<...>() {}; When using code shrinkers (ProGuard, R8, ...) make sure that generic signatures are preserved.
```

### Changes Made

Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r5/work/app/proguard-rules.pro#L1-L13) with the required R8 rules:

1. **Preserve generic type signatures and annotations:** Added `-keepattributes Signature` and `-keepattributes *Annotation*` so generic arguments are preserved in class bytecode.
2. **Preserve `TypeToken` and its subclasses:** Added rules to keep `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and its anonymous subclasses so R8 does not strip or inline them.
3. **Preserve model classes:** Added `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }` so model class fields and constructors are not obfuscated or stripped during deserialization.
